The room

The dormitory is air-conditioned, with lockers and luggage storage.

Layday is small and new. There is a shared kitchen, plus a garden and terrace.

It is quiet, too. One guest called it "very quiet which was amazing".

The shared kitchen has a kettle, a dishwasher and kitchenware, and there is a dining area. The showers are hot.

Just one dorm

There is only the one dormitory. One guest wrote "super clean" and another "very clean". Someone else went as far as "absolutely spotless".

On Hostelworld it scores 10 out of 10 in every category (value for money, security, atmosphere, cleanliness, staff, location and facilities), though that is from ten reviews.

Bed in the dormitory
The only room: one air-conditioned dormitory

Check dates

Newly built, and kept that way

There is housekeeping every day. One guest called the beds "super comfy" and the showers "amazing". Two wrote that they stayed on longer than they had planned, and one was only supposed to stay a night and "ended up here a week".

Finding the door

One guest found it "a little bit difficult to find", so here is the way in. Follow Google Maps. You will come to a large black gate; open it. Through the gate there is a wooden platform with a door through to the Layday area, to the right of the house.

"Well located, very clean, good air conditioning and a great host! Layday Surf is just one dorm room with 4 bunk beds so it is very quiet which was amazing. A little bit difficult to find but the host was very responsive and promises a sign will be put up ASAP."

Catherine, Australia, on Hostelworld, April 2026

Practicalities

14:00–19:00 check-inby 14:00 check-out

Check-in is between 14:00 and 19:00, and check-out is by 14:00. Credit cards are not accepted. Taxes are included, and it is non-smoking.

WiFi is free, and so is the private parking. There is laundry, daily housekeeping, bicycles to rent and an airport shuttle, and pets can come at no extra charge.

Reception has limited hours.
